title: Astro sidebar category
description: A folder's _category_.json or _category_.yml under docs/: how the folder appears in an autogenerated sidebar.

label.description: The category's name in the sidebar; the folder name by default.

position.description: The category's position among its siblings: lower comes first.

collapsible.description: false keeps the category open with no toggle.

className.description: A CSS class on the category's sidebar item.

key.description: A key that keeps two categories with the same label apart.

customProps.description: Your own values on the category's sidebar item.

link.description: What clicking the category opens: {type: doc, id} or {type: generated-index}, or null for nothing.

description.description: The text on the category's generated index page.

image.description: The image on the category's card in generated index pages.
